title: A value replacing a flow mapping after a quoted key written without a space
notes: A quoted key is JSON-like, so its value may follow the `:` directly (production 149) and `{"a":{}}` is valid. Replacing `{}` by the plain scalar `5` and writing `{"a":5}` is valid too, but section 7.4.2 says processors should separate the value from the `:` on output, and a minimal edit changes only the value. Whether the edit keeps the original adjacency or adds the space is a kit convention; the case expects the value written in place, `{"a":5}`.

provenance.reference: An editor that rewrote the separator around a replaced value.
